description.value:
The plants limbs, leaves and roots gently rearrange themselves to take positions that you choose.

You learn which parts of the plant are edible or poisonous.

You gain a fleeting vision of the last creature that touched the plant.

The plant grows as though a month of time has passed. A plant can only grow once in this manner.

You learn what beasts have passed within 10 feet of the plant within the last week.

The plant indicates the direction of the nearest source of fresh water.

You harmlessly extract a pint of sap or syrup from the plant if it is Medium or larger. After you use this feature on a plant, you can’t use it again on that plant until 24 hours have passed.
